scope: Proposition A.2 (Oscillation for the four triples) of the manuscript “Pointwise convergence of fourfold ergodic averages for mixing transformations” (preprints/Pointwise-convergence-of-fourfold-ergodic-averages-for-mixing-transformations-October-4-2026/fourfold-ergodic-averages.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 154 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dbb86e1a3da44a8b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 31-32. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (Y, ν, R) be an invertible probability preserving system, let J ⊂ {1, 2, 3, 4} have three elements, and let the functions gj : Y → C, j ∈ J, 31 be measurable with |gj| ≤ 1. For an averaging profile set V φ k (y) = X n∈Z φ2k (n) Y j∈J gj(Rjn y), k ≥ 0. There is Cφ < ∞ such that, for all deterministic integers 0 ≤ k1 < · · · < kW+1, W X b=1 Z Y max kb≤ℓ≤kb+1 |V φ ℓ − V φ kb | dν ≤ Cφ √ W. (A.13) The constant is independent of the system, inputs, endpoints, and W.
